subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme PoC — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Liz Turner <liz.turner@acme.com>, Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (Acme PoC)

Hi Liz / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and I’ve attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (Acme_MAP_v1.pdf). Please let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency and inconsistent inference costs on current hosted endpoints leading to bad UX during peak traffic windows.
- Lack of model rollout tooling and observability across environments (staging vs prod).
- Security/compliance requirements around audit logs and KMS for customer data.

Primary goals for the PoC:
1) Validate 95th percentile latency under expected load (10k daily active users, spikes to 200 rps).
2) Demonstrate cost-per-1000-requests improvement via batching + caching.
3) Prove ability to pin a model version and rollback with minimal disruption.

Draft mutual action plan (attached) — high-level milestones I put together: 
- Week 1 (by 2026-07-06): Environment access & infra onboarding (VPN + read-only logs) — owners: Acme infra + Redwood infra eng (Rafael).
- Week 2 (by 2026-07-13): Baseline perf & regression tests — owners: Acme SRE + Redwood performance team.
- Week 3–4 (by 2026-07-27): Integrate batching/caching + run load test — owners: Redwood eng + Acme app team.
- Week 5 (by 2026-08-03): Business review & decision checkpoint — stakeholders: Liz (product), Sam (SRE), procurement.

Open questions / asks from your side:
- Can you share the expected traffic profile (CSV) and a sample request payload?
- Who will be the procurement contact for a potential Dedicated capacity purchase?

Next steps I propose:
- Rafael will kick off infra onboarding this Friday and share temporary access.
- Can we schedule a 30-min PoC kickoff next Tue (2026-06-30) at 10am PT?

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (one-page MAP with milestones and owners)

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (Acme PoC)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP, this matches our conversation. A few additions from our side: 

Decision process & timeline:
- Product (me) + SRE (Sam) will do the technical evaluation.
- If the PoC meets latency and cost targets, procurement will start contracting the week of 2026-08-03.
- Final decision expected by 2026-08-10.

Stakeholders to loop in:
- Procurement: Nina Alvarez (nina.alvarez@acme.com) — will need the commercial terms and SLA.
- Legal: Tom Edwards (tom.edwards@acme.com) — for any data processing addenda.

Answering your asks:
- Traffic profile: attaching a small sample file (sample_traffic_profile.csv) — note it’s anonymized.
- Procurement contact: Nina (above).

Confirming the kickoff: Tue 2026-06-30 10am PT works for us. I’ve put a placeholder on my calendar.

One more note: we require that audit logs are retained for 90 days for this PoC; can you confirm Redwood can provide that retention setting in a private PoC environment?

Thanks — Liz
